## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Saṁsaṭṭhānuvattaka* is the thirteenth *saṅghādisesa* rule of the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga in the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule provides that a nun who persistently encourages other nuns to conduct themselves in contravention of the preceding rule concerning corrupt socialization, and who refuses to desist after formal admonishment, commits an offense entailing temporary suspension from the community (*saṅghādisesa*). An English translation of the text has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
